facts.quote: Tonal: Meet Tonal Installation With Tonal Effortless Install, professionals deliver, mount, and test your Tonal for a fast, stress-free setup.

The connected home gym, Tonal, saw huge growth at the start of Covid-19, but needed to connect more with high-income worth individuals and athletes to build the brand interest and value, in a highly competitive market.
Stanley Tonal, a smart home gym looking for a holiday sales boost, has dropped an epic long-form commercial shot entirely in black and white and set in the Victorian era.

parsed.subject: Collaboration Proposal
parsed.body:
Hi Tonal team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting compelling visual narratives for brands. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with Tonal, built around the initial fact that Tonal: Meet Tonal Installation With Tonal Effortless Install, professionals deliver, mount, and test your Tonal for a fast, stress-free setup. You’ve built a powerful brand story through this, and we believe a visual piece that captures the essence of that experience would resonate deeply with your audience. The post could showcase a beautifully rendered, minimalist shot of the Tonal installation, emphasizing the feeling of effortless control and the connection to the Victorian era setting. Together, we envision a post that subtly hints at the potential for a captivating holiday sales boost, offering a glimpse into the future of smart home fitness.  We’d love to collaborate on this – reply if you’re interested!

The BrandPilot team
